label: Diagram 6.2
caption: Diagram 6.2 Marking by a surface
description: This is a section drawing, identified by the word "SECTION" at the lower left and the green title bar at the bottom reading "Diagram 6.2 Marking by a surface". The note "See para 6.1" appears at the top left. On the right side stands a narrow vertical element drawn with double lines, like a post or wall section. From near its top a short horizontal line joins the element to a narrow diagonal line drawn with double lines, which slants down and to the left, ending in a small dot. At the base, a horizontal ground line runs in from the left, rises at a small step, and continues as a scalloped wavy form labelled "Cobbles and very slight change of level". A horizontal double-headed arrow spans the gap between the lower end of the diagonal line and the vertical element, marked "If greater than 100mm". To the right of the vertical element a vertical double-headed arrow indicates a height, marked "If less than 2m".
